items.title: Filemod
items.text: File utility helpers for archives, hashing, and quick backups. Wraps common operations with consistent output and options.

items.title: Functions
items.text:
• extract: Extract common archive formats.
  • filehash: Generate hashes for files with multiple algorithms.
  • backup: Create a timestamped backup copy of a file.
